verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator chip plus its software stack. A sandbox environment kept separate from production data belongs to SaaS and API services, not to accelerator hardware. Nothing in the evidence shows Gaudi 3 offering a sandbox or test-versus-production data separation. The cloud-access mention (docs-16) is a way to try the hardware, not a data-isolated sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
